apps.name: Orivyn
apps.subtitle: Private local AI, without paid tiers
apps.localizedDescription: Independent local-first iPhone assistant with downloadable models, chat history, documents and image text recognition, voice, projects and response preferences. Build 6 adds stricter remote-stream validation and reviewed source-patch export. No subscriptions or paid app tiers; optional remote providers may charge. Unsigned iOS26 development preview; SideStore must sign it. Models download separately. Portable checks, native device compilation and IPA inspection passed. Exact-build native unit/UI tests and physical-device installation/refresh, voice, memory/thermal behavior and Files export remain unverified. General autonomous tool orchestration, broad vision and automatic cross-device sync remain unfinished. Not completed 1.0.0 or an OpenAI product.

versions.localizedDescription:
Unsigned ARM64 iPhone development preview for iOS 26+. SideStore must sign it for your account/device. This is not completed 1.0.0.

Includes the current local-assistant development candidate, with stricter remote-stream choice validation and reviewed source-patch export. Exported patches are drafts: they are not applied or tested automatically, and the base commit/blob must be checked before use. Models download separately; optional remote providers may charge.

Verified for this source: 400 Foundation Swift tests, 104 JavaScript agent tests, 39 VM component tests, and 158 Python tests passed (one existing tokenizer test skipped). Native iOS Release compilation and IPA structure/resource checks passed on Xcode 26.4.1. Native unit/UI tests were not run for this exact build. Physical iPhone installation/refresh, runtime, voice, memory/thermal behavior and Files export remain unverified. General autonomous tool orchestration, broad vision and automatic cross-device sync remain unfinished.

Source commit: 319d6aed0a4e7543d23f96bb2de882cf68616348. CircleCI packaging pipeline 21, job 28.
IPA: Orivyn-0.1.1-build6-unsigned.ipa
Size: 35,042,297 bytes
SHA-256: 86adf180469d44b927cfc078adb5fcf315c5a4da9a1078f613788771640db79e

Required llama.cpp and KaTeX notices are bundled. No private source archive, signing keys, model weights or personal conversations are included. Application source remains private; automatic source archives refer only to this distribution repository. Preserve existing app data and signing identity when updating. Not an OpenAI product.

Build 4 development preview. 288 native and 27 UI tests passed, including real local-model download, inference and relaunch. Distribution package adds the llama.cpp MIT notice; all original application payload bytes are unchanged. Device acceptance remains pending.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take a photo to attach and recognize its text on this iPhone.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Only when you connect to your chosen plugin server, Orivyn may access that server on your local network. Chats and files are not sent automatically.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Only when you tap Get current location, Orivyn asks iOS for a one-time location displayed on this screen. It is not sent to a model or server.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Orivyn uses the microphone only when you start dictation or a voice conversation.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Orivyn transcribes your speech on this iPhone when you start dictation or voice conversation.
